_comment: Freeware games ScummVM 2.9.1 plays, redistributable under their own licences (kept intact: the original archives are downloaded unmodified from downloads.scummvm.org by the engine at first start). One store package per game; variants = the languages offered in the store page (max 6). 'lang' is ScummVM's --language code. gen_games.py fetches sizes + sha256 and writes backend/nucleo-games.h and apps/<id>/manifest.json.

games.name: Beneath a Steel Sky
games.author: Revolution Software
games.description: Cyberpunk adventure by Revolution Software: Robert Foster escapes the dystopian city of Union City. Full CD version with speech and subtitles in several languages.

descriptions.it: Avventura cyberpunk di Revolution Software: Robert Foster fugge dalla distopica Union City. Versione CD completa con parlato inglese e sottotitoli in più lingue.

games.name: Flight of the Amazon Queen
games.author: Interactive Binary Illusions
games.description: Comedy adventure: pilot Joe King crash-lands in the Amazon jungle and must stop a mad scientist. Talkie CD version.

descriptions.it: Avventura comica: il pilota Joe King precipita nella giungla amazzonica e deve fermare uno scienziato pazzo. Versione CD parlata.

games.name: Lure of the Temptress
games.author: Revolution Software
games.description: Revolution's first adventure: the peasant Diermot must free the town of Turnvale from the sorceress Selena. Virtual Theatre characters with a life of their own.

descriptions.it: La prima avventura di Revolution: il contadino Diermot deve liberare Turnvale dalla maga Selena. Personaggi Virtual Theatre che vivono di vita propria.

games.name: Drascula: The Vampire Strikes Back
games.author: Alcachofa Soft
games.description: Spanish comedy adventure: John Hacker travels to Transylvania to rescue his girlfriend from the vampire Drascula. With the CD soundtrack.

descriptions.it: Avventura comica spagnola: John Hacker va in Transilvania a salvare la fidanzata dal vampiro Drascula. Con la colonna sonora del CD.

games.name: DreamWeb
games.author: Creative Reality
games.description: Dark top-down cyberpunk thriller for adults: Ryan must kill seven people to save the DreamWeb. Contains violence and nudity.

descriptions.it: Thriller cyberpunk cupo con visuale dall'alto, per adulti: Ryan deve uccidere sette persone per salvare il DreamWeb. Contiene violenza e nudità.

games.name: Soltys
games.author: L.K. Avalon
games.description: Polish puzzle adventure full of humour: help Soltys, the village headman, through surreal riddles.

descriptions.it: Avventura polacca a enigmi piena di umorismo: aiuta Soltys, il capo del villaggio, tra indovinelli surreali.

games.name: Sfinx
games.author: L.K. Avalon
games.description: Humorous adventure from Avalon: a clumsy hero travels the kingdom to cure the ailing Sphinx.

descriptions.it: Avventura umoristica di Avalon: un eroe maldestro attraversa il regno per curare la Sfinge malata.

games.name: Nippon Safes, Inc.
games.author: Dynabyte
games.description: Italian comedy adventure: three crooks, Dough, Donna and Dino, each with their own story in a crazy Japanese city.

descriptions.it: Avventura comica italiana di Dynabyte: tre imbroglioni, Dough, Donna e Dino, ognuno con la sua storia in una folle città giapponese.
